summary: Diff shows frontend changes in Header and ProfileSection that appear related to avatar display and a remove-photo dialog, but key parts of the remove flow and backend persistence cannot be verified from the provided truncated diff. Backend changes do not include visible logic to clear/persist `profileImage = null`.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add support for removing a user’s profile photo from the Profile page with a clear UI action + confirmation, update profile with `profileImage = null`, immediately fall back to default avatar, clear local preview/selected file state on success or cancel, and persist after reload.
missing_requirements.reason: ProfileSection shows state for a remove-photo dialog (`showRemovePhotoDialog`) and edit cancel cleanup for preview/selected file, but the diff is truncated before any confirmed UI action wiring and before any mutation call that sets `profileImage` to null; also no evidence is shown that AvatarImage is conditionally not rendered after successful removal on the Profile page.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend must persist profile photo removal: updating caller profile with `profileImage = null/none` clears stored image; subsequent profile reads return `profileImage = null`; no other fields changed as side effect.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo changes shown only include type definitions and surrounding context; no evidence is present of update logic handling `null/none` to clear the stored profile image, nor of read methods returning null afterward.
